controls.title: Ensure Web Management is set to use HTTPS
controls.remediation: Enable HTTPS for the pfSense web management interface.

controls.title: Ensure Sessions Timeout is set to less than or equal to 10 Minutes
controls.remediation: Set the management session timeout to 10 minutes or less.

controls.title: Ensure SSH management is enabled for secure administration
controls.remediation: Enable SSH only when required for secure administration.
